title: Medically Necessary Healing, With Marvin Gaye
subtitle: A billing and coding journey
text:
I get phone calls, from friends. I am a know it all. It’s intolerable. I interrupt people. It’s an impairment, I am aware. To make up for it, I am answering the question in reference format here on my newsletter. Welcome to The Frontier Psychiatrists!

Subscribe now

How to get paid for what you do (medical billing and coding edition)…

According to healthcare.gov, medically necessary care is…

Health care services or supplies needed to diagnose or treat an illness, injury, condition, disease or its symptoms and that meet accepted standards of medicine.

I’m going to use absurd examples, cause it is more fun.

I’m also going to find replace a bit with music…I am going to audit a song for medical necessity!

The lyrics are some extensive documentation Let’s see how he does?

Ooh baby, I'm hot just like an oven

Ok, documenting subjective experience of pyrexia. This is starting out better than expected.

I need some lovin'
And baby, I can't hold it much longer

Pretending we are aliens who are not familiar with the very strict standards around “lovin’ in a physician-patient relationship…the documentation notes the urgency of the problem…

It's getting stronger and stronger

Documenting the stability and status of the condition is crucial for accurate billing and coding.

When I get that feeling
I want sexual healing

This is a pretty clear history of symptoms supporting both a diagnosis and treatment plan.

Sexual healing, oh baby
Makes me feel so fine

This documentation supports an effective intervention for the condition, and patient has responded positively in the past, which is in keeping with generally accepted love making at least.

Helps to relieve my mind

This note might support interactive complexity!

Sexual healing baby, is good for me
Sexual healing is something that's good for me

This is repetitive and not required to support the medical necessity of

Whenever blue teardrops are fallin'
And my emotional stability is leaving me

This psychiatric presenting symptom of weeping might be easier to justify than the love making…and clearly, given the reduction in emotional stability, we have a worsening adjustment disorder at worst?

There is something I can do

Effective interventions exist, as detailed in the assessment and plan?

I can get on the telephone and call you up, baby

Well, I have to say, Marvin Gaye really stuck the landing here—from the CMS 2023 post PHE updates this use of telephony for the management of a mental health or substance use disorder absolutely qualifies for billing as an evaluation and management service as long as he is licensed in the state in which the patient is located!

And honey I know you'll be there to relieve me
The love you give to me will free me

Again, “the love”— which from a risk management standpoint I am going to assume is psychotherapy provided to a patient with attachment disruption and erotic transference—is going to relieve the symptoms of emotional instability: severe, worsening as documented above.

If you don't know the thing you're dealing
Oh I can tell you, darling, that it's sexual healing

It’s important to explicitly make the diagnosis (using ICD-10) and associated diagnoses in the assessment.

Let's make love tonight
(Wake up, wake up, wake up, wake up)
'Cause you do it right

This makes a difference with Medicare /Medicaid billing—rarely do commercial plans address this after hour service provision:

Baby, I got sick this mornin' (heal me my darling, heal me my darling)
A sea was stormin' inside of me
Baby, I think I'm capsizin'(heal me my darling, heal me my darling)
The waves are risin' and risin'

This is clearly, by history, an unstable condition:

Medically unstable means a recent acute illness or complications of a chronic condition that are not physically or mentally controlled by diet, medication, or physical exercise and which require frequent monitoring and testing by skilled professionals.

So we are, under E+M guidelines, going to be able to justify more for this encounter.

And when I get that feeling
I want sexual healing
Sexual healing is good for me
Makes me feel so fine, it's such a rush
Helps to relieve the mind, and it's good for us

The issue of course is that sexual healing, as Mr. Gaye intends, is not in keeping with the standards of medical care or practice….so we have a bit of a conundrum from both an ethical and billing and coding perspective.

Come take control, just grab a hold
Of my body and mind, soon we'll be making it, honey
I'll be feeling fine
You're my medicine, open up and let me in
Darling, you're so great, I can't wait for you to operate

Both psychotherapy and surgical care are appropriate medical care, but only one of those procedures can be offered by Telehealth with the patients’ home as a place of service.

I can't wait for you to operate

surgical care does tend to reimburse more robustly, and thus this auditor agrees.

Please don't procrastinate
It's not good to masturbate

This seems like a relevant question for the assessment and plan…but the patients’ disagreement with any other plan probably will Allow for this note to be coded with 90785: Interactive Complexity given his disagreement with any other Treatment plan.

I suspect this session can be appropriately Coded as 99214 + 90833 + 90785.
